Gender-coded language, company by company

Careers-page register for every company in the corpus. One square = one corpus sentence, scored on a gender-coding axis built from pure gender-term pairs (Kozlowski et al. 2019); squares run from most masculine-coded (top) to most feminine-coded (bottom). Prototype — instrument not yet judge-validated.
